- The `generateBundle` hook now builds a real `BuildResult`-shaped object with `outputFiles`, `metafile`, and `mangleCache` all set to `undefined` (plus the required `errors`/`warnings` arrays that the type mandates), then invokes every registered `onEnd` callback with it.
